title: CoTA++: Understanding the Repeat Curse in dMLLMs from an Information Flow Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.23290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iterative denoising with bidirectional attention, which precludes the standard autoregressive key--value cache. Practical deployments therefore rely on approximate caching that reuses intermediate states across denoising steps. Such caching, however, often makes a response repeat one token at adjacent positions in a run that breaks the sentence, a failure we term the \emph{Repeat Curse}. Tracing the context-token information flow reveals three disruptions. Within a step, caching disperses the attention that anchors a position on nearby context tokens. Across steps, similarity-based refresh is not staleness-aware, so some positions are decoded against stale key--value states. translated_title: CoTA++：从信息流视角理解扩散多模态大语言模型中的“重复诅咒”
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）通过带双向注意力的迭代去噪进行解码，这使得标准的自回归键值缓存无法适用。因此，实际部署通常依赖跨去噪步骤复用中间状态的近似缓存。然而，这种缓存常常导致模型在相邻位置连续重复某个词元，形成破坏句子的重复串，我们将这一失效现象称为“重复诅咒”。通过追踪上下文词元的信息流，我们揭示了三类扰动：在单步之内，缓存分散了将某一位置锚定于附近上下文词元的注意力；在步骤之间，基于相似度的刷新机制无法感知状态的陈旧程度，导致某些位置在过时的键值状态上进行解码；在层级之间，出现重复之处上下文的深层熵无法收敛。据此，我们提出了 CoTA++——一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，能够针对上述每一类扰动进行纠正（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文从信息流视角揭示了近似缓存导致扩散多模态大语言模型产生“重复诅咒”的单步、跨步与跨层级三类信息流扰动，并提出无需训练、即插即用的 CoTA++ 框架来逐一消除这些扰动。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three information-flow disruptions—within-step, across-step, and across-layer—caused by approximate caching that lead to the "Repeat Curse" in diffusion-based multimodal LLMs, and proposes CoTA++, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that counteracts each disruption.
